summary: A 24-year-old Durango woman, a Mild to Wild raft guide, drowned in a rafting accident on the Upper Animas River near Tenmile Creek south of Silverton; two rafts of four were running the Silverton-to-Rockwood reach and she fell into the water. Resuscitation efforts by the rafting group were unsuccessful. Silverton Medical Rescue responded to a ~1 p.m. satellite emergency notification device alert, two rescuers were inserted via the Durango & Silverton Narrow Gauge Railroad, and the body was transported out by train.
location: Upper Animas River near Tenmile Creek, south of Silverton
responding_agency: Silverton Medical Rescue; San Juan County Sheriff Office; San Juan County Office of Emergency Management
notes: Date is occurrence Saturday 2023-06-10 (article dated Tue Jun 13, 2023); victim name not published in sourced snippets.
